name: Repair Amplifier - Link
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Link capability.

61230.name: Repair Device I · Link
61230.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
When launching Link Attack, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
